{{Quote|A foreign army invades Taris, declares martial law and locks down all travel to and from the planet? You damn well bet I have a problem with that!|[[Gadon Thek]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The '''capturing''' of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] was an event during the later [[Time/Legends|years]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]] where the loosely defended [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Taris was conquered by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. The Sith installed a government on the planet, deposing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned government. They placed their headquarters within a [[Tarisian military base|military base]] accessible through the [[Upper City]]. From the military facility, a [[Sith Governor|governor]] ruled the planet.

The Sith made some changes to the cultural climate of Taris. For example, they eased up the restrictions of alien species traveling to the Upper City. They also allowed the [[Exchange]], and their leader [[Davik Kang]] to do as they pleased, so long as they did not interfere in Sith business. They also placed [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] throughout the Upper City to assist residents and travelers to the planet on their terms. The occupiers also blocked and limited access between the Upper City into the [[Lower City]], requiring permits or signed papers to be used. Furthermore, the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] was inaccessible without specified orders or using covert, [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]]-controlled access routes.

Following the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]] escaped to the Tarisian surface via [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], as did soldiers [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Carth Onasi]]. Enraged at having not captured Shan, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] ordered the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of Taris through [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] in an effort to kill the targeted Jedi. The bombardment went as planned, in spite of the Sith government and military personnel stationed on the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
The capturing of Taris is mentioned in the game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' briefly in various discussions or alluded to in the same manner.

The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map.<ref name="TEA" />
